exposure: oral synbiotic (Lactobacillus plantarum and fructo-oligosaccharides) preparation
outcome: colonization by Gram-positive genera (Enterococcus, Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium)
cohort: The study included 11 full-term Indian infants delivered by C-section who were part of a previously published clinical study.
finding: Synbiotic treatment induced an increase in overall bacterial taxa and Gram-positive diversity, particularly in the first week of life, marked by an increase in Bacteroidetes, Firmicutes, and Gram-positive genera, and a reduction in Proteobacteria.
